gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.q1: Do I need an account to see any content?
gettingStarted.a1: No — today's Current Affairs preview and full Pricing are public. Most content (Learn, Practice, Analytics) needs a free account, per the platform's public/authenticated content split.
gettingStarted.q2: How do I sign up — do I need to create a password?
gettingStarted.a2: No password, ever, for an individual account. Sign up with Google or a 6-digit email OTP — Nalanda is fully passwordless by design.
gettingStarted.a3: Group 1, Group 2, Group 2A, Group 4, VAO, Police, Forest, and TRB — with more depth added exam-by-exam as the platform grows.

pricingPlans.title: Pricing & Plans
pricingPlans.q1: Is the Free plan actually free, or a time-limited trial?
pricingPlans.a1: Genuinely free, indefinitely — not a trial. It's deliberately usable on its own, with Plus and Pro adding depth (unlimited practice, AI mains evaluation) rather than gating the basics.
pricingPlans.q2: Can I cancel or switch plans anytime?
pricingPlans.a2: Yes — cancel anytime from your account; you keep access until the end of your current billing period, standard SaaS practice.
pricingPlans.q3: Do you offer pricing for coaching centers or institutions?
pricingPlans.a3: Yes — the Institutional tier covers bulk licensing and cohort-level analytics for coaching centers and study centers. Talk to Sales for seat-based pricing.

contentLanguage.title: Content & Language
contentLanguage.q1: Is everything really available in Tamil, not just English with subtitles?
contentLanguage.a1: Yes — Tamil is a first-class citizen throughout the product, typeset with the same care and weight as English everywhere, never a smaller afterthought translation.
contentLanguage.q2: How current is the Current Affairs content?
contentLanguage.a2: Updated daily and tagged by TNPSC exam relevance, so you're not wading through generic news to find what actually matters for your exam.

aiFeatures.title: AI Features
aiFeatures.q1: How does the AI Tutor actually work?
aiFeatures.a1: It answers syllabus questions instantly in Tamil or English. When its confidence is low, it says so honestly and offers to escalate your question to the community instead of guessing.
aiFeatures.q2: Is AI Mains answer evaluation available on every plan?
aiFeatures.a2: It's a Pro-tier feature — evaluates structure, relevance, coverage, and language against a rubric, with actionable feedback rather than just a score.

privacyData.title: Privacy & Data
privacyData.a1: All traffic is encrypted over HTTPS, identity is handled by Firebase Authentication, and Nalanda never stores your card details directly — payments are delegated entirely to Razorpay.
privacyData.q2: Can I export or delete my data?
privacyData.a2: Yes — both are supported directly from your account, in line with India's DPDP Act data rights.
